standup.label: stand up

card.title: STAND UP
card.subtitle: WRITE YOUR SET
rules: Write three stand up jokes from your character's perspective.
Your jokes are saved. After each of the next rounds, one character takes the stage.

prompts: Write three stand up jokes from the perspective of your character.

card.title: PERFORMANCE
card.subtitle: ON STAGE
rules: One character's jokes are on stage.
Comment and engage for {time}. Messages arrive after a 10 second delay.
Then everyone gives a secret thumbs up or thumbs down. A majority of thumbs up earns the performer a point.

question.label: question

card.title: ROUND
card.subtitle: QUESTION ROUND
rules: Next you read everyone's answers and like the ones you like. Each like is a point for that character.
Then you vote on who is behind each character.

prompts: Which character would you want to be close friends with, and why?
What's your dream job, and why?
Tell us a secret you've never told anyone.
What would you get {P} as a gift, and why?
Who is your character most attracted to, and why?
How does your character solve interpersonal conflicts at work?

drawing.label: drawing

card.title: ROUND
card.subtitle: DRAWING ROUND
rules: Next you see everyone's drawings, like the ones you like, and pick one overall favorite.
Then you vote on who is behind each character.

prompts: Draw the greatest day in your character's life.
Draw the object your character values most
